label: Mars30 collaborator dataset - final-submission synthetic study
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC. Not clinically validated. Every figure below is a computed result of this repository's own code against a synthetic dataset.
correction_notice: An earlier version of this study tested the latest ONSD against an absolute 5.0mm cutoff. That was a misreading of the collaborator's specification (personal-baseline-relative, +0.4mm) and produced an unusable ~96-99% false-escalation rate. Corrected 2026-11-15; the superseded run is preserved at handoff/submission/AUDIT_superseded_absolute_cutoff_run/.

dataset.split_unit: astronaut (no astronaut appears in two splits)

ml_baseline.description: Causal-feature models reproduced from the dataset's own baseline_example.py (test split, 45 astronauts). Not the deployed monitoring model - a reference bar.

sans_bayesian_rule.description: Collaborator's corrected 2026-11-15 specification: latest quality-OK ONSD reading tested against this astronaut's own causally-estimated personal baseline (median of the first 3 quality-OK readings seen so far) - positive if >=0.4mm above baseline, applying LR+ 6.93; else LR- 0.04. Single latest reading only, never multiplied across days.
sans_bayesian_rule.authorization_scope: User-relayed approval for this synthetic submission experiment only - not independent written research-lead sign-off, peer review, or clinical validation. The LR values are a real cited figure (Koziarz et al. 2019) for an absolute-cutoff ICU/ICP test; reusing them for this personal-baseline-delta SANS test is an additional reuse choice, not something that study itself measured.

fixed_vs_adaptive.description: SANS only, per directive. Positive test = latest quality-OK ONSD reading >= 0.4mm above this astronaut's own causally-estimated personal baseline (median of the first 3 quality-OK readings this policy has actually taken), NOT an absolute cutoff - corrected 2026-11-15 from an earlier absolute-5.0mm-cutoff version (see handoff/submission/AUDIT_superseded_absolute_cutoff_run/). Alert = posterior >= 15% (decision_tier_thresholds.repeat_min_pct) - the single-latest-reading LR+6.93 model from a 5% prior cannot reach the 40% Consult threshold (posterior caps at ~26.7%), the same structural ceiling test_recovery_acceptance.py documents for the venous LR=10 case. Jugular-only days (4,11,18,25) never carry an ONSD reading.

completed_synthetic_experiments: ML baseline (SANS + venous) reproduced on the real Mars30 train/val/test split
SANS Bayesian probability rule, corrected to the personal-baseline-delta specification
Fixed-vs-adaptive SANS scanning comparison at 3/7/14-day intervals
scientific_assumptions_and_limitations: Every number on this page is synthetic and not clinically validated.
sans_probability_model / onsd_cutoff_risk_mapping are user-relayed approvals for this submission only - see authorization_scope above.
The 5% starting Bayesian prior has no literature source; it mirrors the venous model's identical placeholder for architectural consistency.
The personal baseline is estimated from only the first 3 quality-OK ONSD readings seen so far per astronaut - a documented protocol choice, not a validated clinical baseline-estimation method.
Venous is excluded from the fixed-vs-adaptive scheduling comparison per directive - its jugular scan days (4/11/18/25) are fixed by the dataset's own design, not a policy variable here.
Trigger-firing behavior uses the approved HRV-proxy sensitivity model at accuracy=0.7 (middle of the approved 0.5-0.9 sweep) - not a measured trigger accuracy.
genuinely_blocked_future_work: A venous fixed-vs-adaptive scheduling comparison - the jugular scan schedule is fixed by the dataset design, not a policy this codebase can vary without a different dataset or a new generation model.
Any Urgent-tier demonstration from this dataset - Mars30 has no symptom/red-flag field, and this codebase's Urgent tier is rule-based on red-flag symptoms only, never probability-based.
Independent written research-lead or clinical sign-off on the SANS Bayesian rule - see authorization_scope.
